messages:
sam-oncall: Observed a 0.7% TLS handshake failure spike on eu-west->us-east during the 08:00 deploy. Opening thread for remediation tracking.

mira-sre: Can you paste a sample trace or log line?

sam-oncall: snippet in incident doc. quick grep: `tls: handshake timeout route=eu-west->us-east retries>=2`

zoe-net: looking at LB egress now. I see SYN retransmits and MSS anomalies on SYN-ACKs during 08:02-08:18. Likely PMTU / middlebox dropping fragments.

dan-platform: note the canary enabled sticky routing which may have concentrated traffic to a few gateways. that could explain the localized spike.

mira-sre: Action: zoe to capture pcaps + run traceroute/tcp replay against gateway and upload to s3. owner=zoe-net, due=EOD Thu.

zoe-net: ack. will capture pcap and run synthetic; plan to test `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` on a staging gateway.

ashley-pm: we should have an automated gate: if handshake_fail_rate > 0.5% for 10m during deploy, trigger rollback. who owns that?

dan-platform: platform team owns deploy gates. I'll add an alert + automated rollback playbook. ETA 48h.

ops-bot: INC-5233 created: "cross-region TLS handshake spike during canary" assigned to zoe-net, mira-sre.

mira-sre: also adding per-route handshake-failure metric to Console. owner=mira-sre, PR target=next Tue.

zoe-net: staging test: enabling mtu probing on the gateway improved handshake success from 99.3% -> 99.99% on synthetic load. uploaded pcap: s3://redwood-logs/pcaps/1901234567-mtu-test.pcap

dan-platform: wired alert + rollback playbook; runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress-handshake-failures. playbook will post to this thread on trigger.

mira-sre: Proposed follow-ups: 1) short-term: enable mtu probing on gateway fleet (canary then prod). 2) mid-term: per-route metrics + dashboard. 3) long-term: recurring 3-week postmortem cadence to detect recurring retry patterns. owners: zoe, mira, platform.

sam-oncall: Action summary: zoe-net - staging pcap + validation (EOD Thu); dan-platform - alert & rollback automation (48h); mira-sre - per-route metric PR (next Tue) + cadence; ashley-pm - schedule status check and customer comms if needed. Close after 24h prod stable.

zoe-net: starting canary rollout of mtu_probing change now (eu-west-canary) with 5m observation windows.

ops-bot: RDW-429 created for per-route metrics work.

mira-sre: saw prod stable after 6h, leaving thread open 24h before close. will add final notes to incident doc.
